business_problem: SulAmérica needed to replace a database-heavy batch architecture that could not reliably handle more than five million daily events or move data into CRM fast enough to support modern insurance operations.
solution_summary: SulAmérica replaced database-heavy, batch-based integration with an interoperability platform built on Confluent Cloud alongside Google Cloud Platform and AWS. Instead of moving more than five million daily events through brittle database jobs and legacy brokers, the insurer now organizes source data into governed topics on a streaming backbone that internal teams can reuse across domains. The new design standardizes event and schema management, keeps information flowing continuously into CRM and downstream applications, and lets new data sources be mapped once and exposed as a single source of truth. Because Confluent Cloud removed the burden of installing and operating Kafka infrastructure, SulAmérica could concentrate on stream design, partner integration, and business logic rather than ZooKeeper and manual recovery. The same foundation now supports broader Kafka adoption across teams, planned ksqlDB-based stream processing, and improved observability.

solution_components.name: Confluent Cloud
solution_components.role: Runs SulAmérica's interoperability platform and streaming backbone for continuously moving insurance data into reusable topics.

data_flow: Doctor, patient, broker, and partner events flow into Confluent Cloud, where SulAmérica organizes them into topics and schemas on its interoperability platform, then streams the data into CRM and other consuming teams within minutes while new connectors bring additional sources into the same single source of truth.
business_outcome: SulAmérica cut CRM latency from almost 24 hours to 3 to 5 minutes, stopped losing events, scaled its data platform automatically, and created a reusable single source of truth that multiple teams can build on as open insurance and open banking increase competition.
metrics: more than five million daily events
architecture_clues: SulAmérica established an interoperability platform as its new architecture standard for streaming data.
Data is organized into clean, stable, described topics that act as reusable interfaces for multiple teams.
The broker layer scales automatically and the platform was required to operate without losing a single event.
The team is extending the platform with better observability and future ksqlDB-based stream processing.
